summary: In April 2020, the custom printed apparel website Teespring suffered a data breach that exposed 8.2 million customer records. The data included email addresses, names, geographic locations and social media IDs.

title: Fotolog: 16.7M accounts breached
summary: In December 2018, the photo sharing social network Fotolog suffered a data breach that exposed 16.7 million unique email addresses. title: Domino's India: 22.5M accounts breached
summary: In April 2021, 13TB of compromised Domino's India appeared for sale on a hacking forum after which the company acknowledged a major data breach they dated back to March. title: JD: 77.4M accounts breached
